origin.description: Return only the neighbor index matrix from get.knn.
origin.details: The matrix has one row per training point and k columns.
origin.example: knn.index of cbind(1:10, 1:10), k=5, default kd_tree

translation.description: knn_index returns the index matrix from get_knn.
translation.details: The matrix has one row per training point and k columns.
translation.example: knn.index of cbind(1:10, 1:10), k=5, default kd_tree
